add.title: Add Livestock
add.description: Fill in the details for one animal. You'll review and sign on the next step.
add.hintDone: All required details are filled in · Step 1 of 2

ocr.entryDescription: Fill animal details from a birth record or veterinary certificate.
ocr.title: Import certificate with OCR
ocr.description: Upload up to three clear pages for the same animal, then review every detected value.
ocr.privateDescription: The selected document images stay in your browser and are not uploaded to QURBI.
ocr.fileHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to {{count}} pages · 10 MB each
ocr.invalidFile: Use JPG, PNG or WebP images no larger than 10 MB each.
ocr.failed: The certificate could not be read. Use a clearer, well-lit image and try again.
ocr.noIndividualData: No supported animal details were detected. Check the image or enter the information manually.
ocr.reviewDescription: Confirm the values before filling the animal form.
ocr.conflictsFound: Some pages contain different values. The strongest result is shown; verify highlighted fields manually.
ocr.applyHelp: Only detected fields will be filled. Empty OCR fields will not erase information already entered.
ocr.notVerification: OCR reads text only. It does not prove that a certificate is genuine or valid.
